dispute.claim_text: I left twenty minutes of buffer over the app's own estimate. The ride took 67 minutes. I missed my train and everything after it. Two hundred dollars of changes. The platform kept offering a hundred-dollar voucher for a week. My loss is real money, not vouchers.

counterparty_statement.text: There was an accident on the expressway; I stayed on the fastest route the app gave me. I can't control traffic.

admissibility.notes: Driver device telemetry at 10 s cadence.
In-app chat export for the trip.
Ledger line items for the trip.
LTA DataMall advisory covering the trip window.
